description: This file contains a Python class 'DarkMonitor' that generates and manages Bokeh plots for dark current monitoring in a space telescope instrument, including database interactions, data processing, and plot updates.

classes.name: DarkMonitor
classes.description: A Bokeh-based class for monitoring dark current in space telescope instruments, with methods for data loading, plot updating, and database interaction.

methods.name: aperture_info
methods.description: Property getter for instrument and aperture info.

methods.name: aperture_info
methods.description: Property setter for instrument and aperture info, triggers re-initialization.

methods.name: _dark_mean_image
methods.description: Updates Bokeh plots with the mean dark image data from FITS files.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Initial setup before data loading, sets default values and configurations.

methods.name: post_init
methods.description: Post-initialization steps to update plots after data is loaded.

methods.name: identify_tables
methods.description: Determines database tables based on instrument name.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Queries database tables to load dark current data.

methods.name: _update_dark_v_time
methods.description: Updates plot ranges and titles for dark current vs. time plot.

methods.name: _update_hist
methods.description: Updates plot ranges and titles for dark current histogram.
